Both Android phones need this Mi Mover lab2. Choose data on the old phone; receive and restore approved categories on the new one.

Create a local hotspot first, or explicitly choose the same-router fallback.

Android could not create the hotspot, or it disconnected. Check nearby-device permission; Android 12 and below also need location permission and the location setting. Same-router fallback is available.
Hotspot created, but the local address is not uniquely known. Check the candidates below and confirm manually; no gateway is guessed.

Nearby Wi-Fi permission is needed. Android 12 and below request precise and approximate location together and may need location enabled; approximate-only access may be insufficient. This app does not read location. If denied, use the same router. Android confirms the connection; mobile data is unchanged.
Android 8/9: join hotspot manually
Open Wi-Fi settings on this old phone and join the new phone hotspot: %1$s. Password: %2$s. Return here and start the transfer after connecting.

QR could not be read, expired or invalid. System-camera thumbnails may be insufficient: fill the frame with the QR, or use a clear local image/development-test long code.
Reading QR in the background for up to 30 seconds. Stop or edit the pairing code to cancel.
QR reading timed out; the old result will not be applied. Cancelling the provider: wait and check the file app if it does not close.
The previous QR task is still stopping or waiting for its provider to close. Reading again is unavailable yet; wait and check the file app if it does not respond.
QR cancellation requested; the old result will not be entered. Reading again requires the provider to close.
Scan inside the app, or read a QR image. The code contains temporary Wi-Fi and pairing credentials. Keep it private.
Requesting the Android foreground transfer service…

Android refused to start or promote the foreground transfer service. The session did not start or was aborted. Check notifications, permissions and system restrictions and pair again; unfinished items are not successful.
Stopping and waiting for file providers and tasks to close. Review unfinished items; retry is unavailable until closure. %1$s
This assistant itself does not upload to the website. Selected SAF file providers may connect or sync independently. Prefer a local destination folder on the new phone and check provider settings.

Export authorized contacts using the system vCard provider, including fields and photos it actually supplies. Failed standard exports are reported as partial, with a basic name/phone/email fallback when available. Confirm account and duplicates separately in the system Contacts app.
Check selected files and create pairing code

The new phone shows this temporary code to the old phone. It contains hotspot credentials: share only with your device. Unpaired codes expire after 10 minutes; confirmed transfer duration is unrestricted.

Local network permission is needed to transfer selected data to the paired phone on the same Wi-Fi. Denial prevents connection.
Notifications show the transfer and a stop action. You may continue if notifications are denied. Keep both phones awake and allow background activity during transfer.
Permission denied or revoked. File selection remains available; check permissions and retry.
Data transfer active. Open the app or stop.
The unapproved join code expired. Stop and generate a new code on the new phone; the scan and completed records are kept.
Session stopped. Old-phone originals and saved received files kept.
The system ended the foreground transfer service. Unfinished items are not successful; keep the app open and pair again.
Connect both phones to the same private Wi-Fi. Guest isolation, VPNs or router settings may block direct connection.
Either phone did not approve or rejected pairing; data contents were not opened.
Secure connection or certificate verification failed. Transfer refused; check the pairing code.
Source changed or received-file verification failed. This item did not succeed; keep originals and review before retrying.

This item failed; removal of the unfinished file is unconfirmed and its record is retained. Check the original destination; deselect the problem item and pair again to continue. Old remnants do not block new receiving.
Connection or file operation failed. Unfinished items did not succeed. Check Wi-Fi, code, free space and folder permissions. Retry within the same session; failed files restart from the beginning.
Could not start this action. Check permissions and system status before retrying.
Could not confirm cleanup of old temporary pairing keys. Restart the app and retry.

Encrypted local transfer checks length and SHA-256 while receiving. Records are saved after successful writing and closing; new files are not reread in full. File saving and restoration are counted separately.

Private app data, logins, chats, SMS, calls, passwords and protected spaces need their own migration. Recurring events and unsupported fields remain archived; app installation needs Android confirmation.
Clearing starts a new transfer task. Completed files are kept; phone originals are not deleted.

No total file-count or duration limit for selected data. Up to 5 automatic reconnections, then user attention is required. After stop/app exit, pair again: the same task and destination recheck completed objects; incomplete files restart. No byte-offset resume.
File requiring attention: %1$s. %2$s Completed files are kept; deselect this item or review permissions/space and pair again.
Rescanning starts a new task and resets selection; originals and completed destination files stay.
A scan scope is incomplete; the index covers only data already read. Adding other folders does not complete the earlier scope; rescan the phone or the same folder.

%1$d unfinished-file records are retained, possibly from different or unknown previous folders. Check the original destination in its file manager; deletion and success are unconfirmed. New receiving can continue and new files will not overwrite them.
Folder scan ended: %1$d items, %2$d failures; an earlier scan remains incomplete and the index covers only data already read.
No completed phone scan is recorded; manually selected files or folders cover only the chosen scope. Unscanned phone data is not migrated.
%1$d files saved; waiting for the old phone’s final receipt.
%1$d files saved, but final sender confirmation is missing. Check the old phone.
If the system refuses automatic hotspot creation, turn on a WPA2 hotspot in system settings and enter its exact name and password below. Then keep the hotspot on while the old phone scans the code.
